HASS It All: Your future starts here!

Home to over 6,000 undergraduate and graduate students, the College brings together four distinct schools.

School of Art, Design and Media

The School of Art, Design and Media offers studio-based undergraduate degree programmes.

Bachelor of Fine Arts in Art, Design and Media

For details of the BFA programme, please view the programme page.

School of Humanities

The School of Humanities offers degrees in five disciplines.

Bachelor of Arts (Hons)

Majors: Chinese, English, History, Linguistics and Multilingual Studies, Philosophy.

School of Social Sciences

The School of Social Sciences offers degrees in four disciplines.

Bachelor of Social Sciences (Hons)

Majors: Economics, Psychology, Public Policy and Global Affairs, Sociology.
